# Room platform 7 x 5 tiles: a flagstone top (textures/floor_7x5.png), stone walls 0.46 m deep
# with a darker footing band, and a tapering rock root beneath. Origin: the top's centre. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Floor --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material new Wall --base-color 0.1451 0.1647 0.1765 --no-slot
material new Footing --base-color 0.0980 0.1294 0.0980 --no-slot
material new Root --base-color 0.1451 0.1647 0.1765 --no-slot
add mesh plane --name Top --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 7 5 1
apply --scale
material assign Floor
active Top
mode edit
select all
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
material texture Floor base-color textures/floor_7x5.png
add mesh cube --name Wall --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 -0.200
scale 7.000 5.000 0.300
apply --scale
material assign Wall
active Wall
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh cube --name Footing --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 -0.430
scale 6.940 4.940 0.160
apply --scale
material assign Footing
active Footing
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh cone --name Root --vertices 8 --radius1 0.5 --radius2 1 --depth 1.0 --location 0 0 -1.0
scale 4.340 3.100 1
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 22.5
apply --rotation
material assign Root
active Root
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
delete only-faces
randomize --amount 0.06 --seed 7
mode object
select all
shade flat
export room7x5.glb
